title: Agreeing to Disagree: Annotating Offensive Language Datasets with Annotators' Disagreement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the impact of inter-annotator disagreement (used as a proxy for subjective interpretation and personal bias) on the performance of offensive language detection models. The study measures classifier F1 scores across training and test splits that are deliberately partitioned by different levels of human consensus (unanimous, mild, and weak agreement).
